tasks.title: Task 1 Create or edit a congress

steps.text: Open the admin. You are already signed in.
In the left-hand menu, choose « Congrès », then « Ajouter un congrès ».
Fill in the name, dates, city and discipline, then publish. To change one, open it from « Tous les congrès ».

notes: To see the review step, sign out (« Retour au site », then « Se déconnecter »), sign in as contributeur, and your congress waits for review before it goes live.

steps.text: Open the team console and sign in as contributeur.
Open the list of congresses and click « Ajouter un congrès », or open an existing one to change it.
Send it for review. Sign in as direction to check it and publish it.

tasks.title: Task 2 Find a congress in the public catalogue

steps.text: Open the visitor site and go to the congress catalogue.
Type a word in the search box, or narrow the list by discipline, country or month.
Open a congress to see its details page: dates, city, venue and discipline.

tasks.title: Task 4 Receive, view, track and update enquiries

steps.text: In the same tab as task 3, click « Espace équipe » and sign in as equipe. Open « Demandes »: your enquiry is at the top.
Open it and change its status, for example from « Nouvelle » to « Qualifiée ». Each change is kept in its history.
Click « Exporter en CSV » to download the list as a spreadsheet file. « Journal des notifications » shows the message your team would have received.
Open the team console, sign in as equipe and open « Demandes ».
Open your enquiry from task 3 and change its status. Each change is kept in its history.
Click « Exporter en CSV » to download the list as a spreadsheet file. « Journal des notifications » shows the message your team would have received.

group.text: Works in the Option B demo Suggestion only One more idea: a link for group trips For a group going to a congress, someone has to collect each traveller’s details and bring them together in one list. What it does Your team sends one link for the enquiry, in its reply to the client. Each traveller fills in their own details on a phone: name as on the ID document, email, departure city and dates. Your team sees the list fill in, with a « répondus / attendus » counter and a ready-to-use export, « Exporter pour cotation (CSV) ». How to try it Open enquiry DV-2026-0001 in the Option B console (new tab) and sign in as equipe, password demo-asset. Choose the « Groupe » tab. Three fictional travellers have already answered. Under « Lien de groupe », copy the link and open it in another tab. This is the traveller’s page. Send an answer, then go back to the « Groupe » tab: it is in the list. The traveller’s page does not show the other travellers, codes or fares. Where it stands Working in Option B’s demonstration, with fictional travellers, as an illustration. Suggestion only. It is not included in the proposal to come, and the requirements and budget you communicated stay unchanged. It exists in Option B’s demo only. If ASSET wants it, it would be scoped and quoted separately for the option you choose, after the proposal, and built only on your written agreement. Limits of the demo A traveller who changes phone cannot correct their entry directly: the change waits for your team to accept it. If the idea is taken up, an email confirmation step would be part of that separate scope. Anyone the link is forwarded to can answer. Revoking it stops that at once. Reminders by email and a status per traveller would belong to that separate scope as well.

passA: Option A A WordPress The system your current site already runs on, with a plugin we wrote for ASSET. It runs inside WordPress Playground: a complete WordPress that runs entirely in your browser, with nothing to install. WordPress starts fresh each time you open one of these links, so nothing from an earlier visit is kept. Open the visitor site of Option A (new tab) Takes about 15 to 25 seconds to start. If it stays on the loading screen, reload the page. Open the admin, signed in to Option A (new tab) Takes about 15 to 25 seconds to start. If it stays on the loading screen, reload the page. The admin link signs you in automatically as « direction ». To follow one enquiry from start to finish, use the visitor site and its « Espace équipe » link: each link opens its own separate copy.
passB: Option B B Our custom platform The Console from our earlier concept, made real. Public pages for your visitors, a small console for your team, and a database behind them, running on Cloudflare, a global network that serves websites. Opens straight away in your browser, with nothing to install.
